CanvasDocument.description:
Persisted visual state keyed to one immutable Publication IR revision.

This model intentionally contains no architecture parameters, source anchors, ports,
edges, or source-write payload. Those facts belong to other, independently validated
protocols.
CanvasDocument.title: CanvasDocument

CanvasNodeState.description: Per-publication-node visual state; it cannot encode a graph or source patch.
CanvasNodeState.title: CanvasNodeState

CanvasNodeStyle.description: A deliberately small, visual-only style palette.
CanvasNodeStyle.title: CanvasNodeStyle

CanvasViewport.description: The client viewport, intentionally independent from publication geometry.
CanvasViewport.title: CanvasViewport

LoadedAnalysisResult.description: A cache-backed analysis bundle for a restarting Engine client.
LoadedAnalysisResult.title: LoadedAnalysisResult

MiniatureEvidenceKind.description: The permitted provenance for a scientific miniature.
MiniatureEvidenceKind.title: MiniatureEvidenceKind

PublicationMiniature.description: A source-mapped visual preview with explicit evidence or schematic disclosure.
PublicationMiniature.title: PublicationMiniature

PublicationMiniatureKind.description: Read-only scientific visual grammars, never additional architecture nodes.
PublicationMiniatureKind.title: PublicationMiniatureKind

SourceLocationResult.description: An Engine-approved source jump target, intentionally without source bytes.
SourceLocationResult.title: SourceLocationResult

VisualPatch.description: Persisted presentation state; it contains no source or architecture edit payload.
VisualPatch.title: VisualPatch
